clientScopes.description: CIP optional scope (audit read): Read the token tenant's audit trail. Read-only and separate from tenant and connector administration. Per-token, role-gated, tenant-bound; never a default.
clientScopes.name: cip.audit.read

clientScopes.description: CIP optional scope (connector administration): Install, configure, enable and disable connectors for the token tenant and bind OpenBao credential references. Never reads secret values. Per-token, role-gated, tenant-bound; never a default.
clientScopes.name: cip.connector.admin

clientScopes.description: CIP optional scope (tenant administration): Administer the token tenant's own CIP settings, projects and member role requests. Never cross-tenant, never realm or platform administration. Per-token, role-gated, tenant-bound; never a default.
clientScopes.name: cip.tenant.admin

clientScopes.description: CIP optional scope (usage read): Read metering and usage for the token tenant (and its projects when narrowed). Read-only; no billing or quota mutation. Per-token, role-gated, tenant-bound; never a default.
clientScopes.name: cip.usage.read

clientScopes.description: CIP human tenant context: tenant_id and project_ids from admin-only codestra_* profile attributes, plus amr. Default scope of CIP browser clients only; never a realm default or on a service client, and not an authorization scope.
clientScopes.name: cip.user.context

clientScopes.description: Codestra optional monitoring scope managed by protected Keycloak GitOps. It is requested explicitly per short-lived service-account token.

clientScopes.description: Codestra optional monitoring scope managed by protected Keycloak GitOps. It is requested explicitly per short-lived service-account token.
clientScopes.name: metrics.read

clientScopes.description: Codestra shared-edge scope: n8n reads a delivered automation result (GET /api/v1/integrations/n8n/results/{event_id}). Explicit per-client default scope only; never a realm default or optional scope.

clientScopes.description: Codestra shared-edge ingress scope managed by protected Keycloak GitOps. n8n submits automation results to Middleware: POST /api/v1/integrations/n8n/results. Attached only as an explicit per-client default scope; never a realm default or optional scope.

clientScopes.description: Codestra shared-edge scope: read a campaign and its desired state through Middleware (GET /api/v1/integrations/odoo/campaigns/{campaign_id}[/desired-state]). Explicit per-client default scope only.

clientScopes.description: Codestra optional workload scope, requested per short-lived service-account token to authenticate to OpenBao; adds the openbao audience and the codestra_environment claim. Never a realm default.

clientScopes.description: Middleware V3 kernel scope: submit or cancel a command. Explicit per-token request; never a realm default. Route digest 9c32daecd4a15104c6f9ff60ce19c8f7e78707fb31d9fd9fcb55b1b8dfa3512b. Attached to no client until PAS-157 resolves the caller.

clientScopes.description: Middleware V3 kernel scope: read operations, timelines and the kernel description. Explicit per-token request; never a realm default. Route digest 9c32daecd4a15104c6f9ff60ce19c8f7e78707fb31d9fd9fcb55b1b8dfa3512b. Unattached until PAS-157.
clientScopes.name: platform.command.read

clientScopes.description: Middleware V3 kernel scope: replay an operation (POST /platform/v1/operations/{operation_id}/replay). Per-token request; never a realm default. Route digest 9c32daecd4a15104c6f9ff60ce19c8f7e78707fb31d9fd9fcb55b1b8dfa3512b. Unattached until PAS-157.
clientScopes.name: platform.command.replay

client.description: TEST_SYN edge-certification identity (Keycloak -> Caddy -> Kong -> Middleware). Submits one safe TEST_SYN n8n result through the shared edge; expected 202. Staging only; never a production client.

client.description: TEST_SYN edge-certification identity (Keycloak -> Caddy -> Kong -> Middleware). Reads campaign TEST_SYN and its desired state; expected 200 from staging Odoo through Middleware. Staging only; never a production client.
client.name: Codestra edge-certification identity: test-syn-odoo-reader

client.description: TEST_SYN edge-certification identity (Keycloak -> Caddy -> Kong -> Middleware). Valid staging token whose audience is not the Middleware/Kong audience; expected 401 on every route. Staging only; never a production client.
client.name: Codestra edge-certification identity: test-syn-wrong-audience

client.description: TEST_SYN edge-certification identity (Keycloak -> Caddy -> Kong -> Middleware). Valid audience and scopes bound to another tenant; expects the same 404 body as a missing result and an identical campaign denial. Staging only; never a production client.
client.name: Codestra edge-certification identity: test-syn-wrong-tenant
